bug_fixes.error_pattern: JSON arrays inside `core_reference.json` contained object-style key/value literals such as `"auto_generated": true`.
bug_fixes.root_cause: Schema field lists were written with object syntax instead of plain string entries, which made `core_reference.json` unparsable.
bug_fixes.prevention_method: Validate JSON syntax after core-reference edits and keep required/optional field lists as strings only.
bug_fixes.architectural_impact: Restores parseability for automation that depends on `core_reference.json`.
